mapper.select:
SELECT model_no, title, brand, description, product_type, gender, color, colorway, upper_material, image_urls, source, source_updated_at, manual_override, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM product_catalog
ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC, model_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_catalog (model_no, title, brand, description, product_type, gender, color, colorway, upper_material, image_urls, source, source_updated_at, manual_override) VALUES (#{modelNo}, #{title}, #{brand}, #{description}, #{productType}, #{gender}, #{color}, #{colorway}, #{upperMaterial}, #{imageUrls}, #{source}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(title), title), brand = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(brand), brand), description = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(description), description), product_type = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(product_type), product_type), gender = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(gender), gender), color = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(color), color), colorway = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(colorway), colorway), upper_material = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(upper_material), upper_material), image_urls = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(image_urls), image_urls), source = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(source), source), source_updated_at = IF(manual_override = 0, VALUES(source_updated_at), source_updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE product_catalog SET title = #{title}, brand = #{brand}, description = #{description}, product_type = #{productType}, gender = #{gender}, color = #{color}, colorway = #{colorway}, upper_material = #{upperMaterial}, image_urls = #{imageUrls}, manual_override = 1 WHERE model_no = #{modelNo}
